frozen_definitions.observable: Green-function residue weight per mode: w_i = |<L_i, b>| * |<R_i, b>| for source/probe vector b (unit dipole at inner boundary channel 0), eigenpairs (w_i, L_i, R_i) of the discretized 3-DOF radial operator assembled from the certified profiles
frozen_definitions.weight_entropy: S = -sum p_i log p_i with p_i = w_i / sum(w) over the scanned window
frozen_definitions.selectivity_metric: C = max_i p_i (Weisz-comparable: fraction of total weight in the strongest mode)
frozen_definitions.robustness: each diagnostic recomputed at 2 grid resolutions and 2 boundary treatments (Dirichlet, Robin); a value is reported only if it varies <5% across all four

acceptance.pass: weight spectrum computed with all four robustness variants agreeing; selectivity C and entropy S reported per scanned window with uncertainty from the variants
acceptance.fail: variants disagree >5% -> diagnostic reported as UNSTABLE, no physical claim
acceptance.null_interpretation: if all residues fall below the null band from off-resonance background, the result is 'no measurable spectral weight in the scanned window' — a valid observational-class (NUMERICALLY_VERIFIED) answer to the owner's question
